meta.title: Operation Knife Edge — The Council of Knives

dossier.overview: Following the ORIZON-4 incident, Bureau Noir Secretariat directed Team Bravo to Concilium on Dawn to support security for the Council of Knives. Gypsy returned from SHIFA and deployed while still under leadership review. Buzzkill, Anya, Dr Farid Qassim 'Q', Sergeant Major Rabbit and Ariadnan assassin Tom Hendry ('Jobe') were also present. En route, the team rested, received medical care and repaired armour before arriving at Concilium. Captain Yelena Voronina of Stavka / Special Operations Command received the team and escorted them to Colonel Darya Moroz, commanding officer of Concilium. After a heated exchange, Moroz allowed Team Bravo to present its case to the secret eight-person Council of Knives and authorised Q to conduct MIRRORGLASS compatibility scans. The highest compatibility results were Simon Blumfeld at 95%, Charlton Branson at 89% and Margaret Fuhler at 85%. During the scans, an EMT grenade disabled the heavy infantry guard detail. Ten unaffected guards were revealed as MIRRORGLASS copies and attempted to abduct several principals. Four copies escaped by base jump with apparent captives Nadya Orlova, Simon Blumfeld, Charlton Branson and Margaret Fuhler. Rabbit, Gypsy, Buzzkill and Anya pursued down the mountain while Q and Tom remained at Concilium. The real Nadya Orlova then arrived after flight delays, proving the Orlova previously present at the summit was already a MIRRORGLASS copy. During the mountain chase, the apparent abductees turned on Team Bravo, confirming that multiple principals in the fleeing group were also copies. Team Bravo ultimately destroyed all escaping MIRRORGLASS security copies and imposter principals. Meanwhile, Q and Tom traced the homing signatures of the genuine Simon Blumfeld, Charlton Branson and Margaret Fuhler into an underground bunker beneath Concilium. The three real principals were found alive in MIRRORGLASS chambers in suspended animation, indicating they had been abducted and copied before the summit. Q stabilised them while Tom accessed a communications node and made direct contact with PALE/07. PALE expressed disappointment that Buzzkill was not present, then stated that it had what it needed and suggested they might meet again at Daybreak. Post-operation analysis confirmed that all eight genuine principals survived, the active copies were destroyed, and data stolen from Bureau Toth has enabled PALE to begin masking MIRRORGLASS signatures, making future scans less reliable. A recovered bunker transfer order and physical freight ledger identified DAYBREAK GATE as the next destination and showed three biological seed consignments routed through the officially mothballed installation. Bureau Noir confirmed Daybreak Gate had resumed communications and had been transmitting for approximately one hour. Following the operation, Ariadnan authorities approved the Ariadnan Cross of Valour for Sergeant Major Rabbit and recommended the same honour for Tom Hendry, with Hendry's confirmation held pending a satisfactory personal conduct review and a recommended Operational Wellness and Readiness Workshop referral. Gypsy, Dr Farid Qassim 'Operator Q', Buzzkill and Anya were awarded the Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship. Bureau Noir also closed Gypsy's outstanding leadership review and restored his line-leadership eligibility without displacing Rabbit's current appointment as Team Leader.

log.entry: Team Bravo personnel present for Operation Knife Edge were Gypsy, Buzzkill, Anya, Dr Farid Qassim 'Q', Sergeant Major Rabbit and Tom Hendry ('Jobe'). Rabbit remained Team Leader. Gypsy had returned from SHIFA but remained under leadership review.
Bureau Noir Secretariat directed Team Bravo to Concilium on Dawn to support security for the Council of Knives event.
Bureau Noir sent Gypsy and Ariadnan assassin Tom Hendry from Dawn to support the Concilium mission.
En route to Concilium, Team Bravo rested, received medical treatment and repaired or mended damaged armour before arrival.
Upon arrival, Team Bravo was received by Captain Yelena Voronina of Stavka / Special Operations Command, Captain of Concilium security.
Captain Voronina recognised Tom Hendry and exchanged curt remarks with him.
Rabbit judged that Voronina’s guarded exchange with Hendry was deliberate tradecraft: she was using interrogation and behavioural cues to satisfy herself that Tom was not an impostor.

Voronina brought Team Bravo before Colonel Darya Moroz, commanding officer of Concilium. Moroz oversaw daily Concilium operations and was responsible for summit security whenever the Council of Knives convened.
Moroz confirmed that he had received an official O-12 request authorising Team Bravo to support the summit and directing that Q scan the principals as a safety measure.
Colonel Moroz was unconvinced by Team Bravo’s intentions and challenged the need for O-12 involvement.
Q and Rabbit engaged in a heated exchange with Colonel Moroz concerning the scan requirement and Team Bravo’s role.
Despite his reservations, Moroz ultimately granted Team Bravo an audience with the Council of Knives.

Buzzkill observed that Ariadna used far less visible advanced technology than he was accustomed to. He was unsettled by how little he understood about Ariadnan countermeasures and what systems he could rely upon if security failed.
Team Bravo entered the Council chamber and saw the eight secret principals of the Council of Knives.

Rabbit regarded the meeting as an honour. Ariadna deliberately concealed the identities of the Council of Knives for leadership security. Rabbit recognised some members as war heroes, while others appeared to have maintained civilian or low-profile lives.
Rabbit and Q persuaded the Council to vote on whether the principals would submit to MIRRORGLASS compatibility scans.
Nadya Orlova consented but filed a formal protest over irregular protocols. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 18%.
Simon Blumfeld consented. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 95%.
Vladimir Tarkov consented but filed a formal protest over irregular protocols. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 76%.
Devan Sanders, Head Councilman, consented. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 59%.
Ayra Spelling consented. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 45%.
Natalya Smirnova consented. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 34%.
Charlton Branson consented. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 89%.
Margaret Fuhler consented. MIRRORGLASS Compatibility Matrix result: 85%.
Based on compatibility scores, Q identified Simon Blumfeld, Charlton Branson and Margaret Fuhler as the most likely high-value MIRRORGLASS targets.
Gypsy continued adjusting to his SHIFA-modified body after his prior KIA. The unfamiliar enhancements left him distracted and still relearning his physical limits.
Anya studied roughly forty security personnel in the chamber and noticed at least seven guards with mismatched uniform details and/or behaviour inconsistent with the surrounding security detail.
While Q and Rabbit conducted the scans, an EMT grenade detonated inside the Council chamber and disabled the heavy infantry guards.
Approximately ten security personnel remained unaffected by the EMT effect.
The ten unaffected guards were revealed as MIRRORGLASS copies and immediately turned on the summit.
The MIRRORGLASS security copies attempted to abduct Council principals while fighting Team Bravo.
Four MIRRORGLASS copies escaped the chamber by base-jumping from the castle/ridge toward four armoured Ariadnan jeeps waiting below.
The apparent abducted principals were Nadya Orlova, Simon Blumfeld, Charlton Branson and Margaret Fuhler.
Rabbit, Gypsy, Buzzkill and Anya acquired manual parachutes and pursued the escaping force by base jump.
Q and Tom Hendry remained at Concilium to provide medical and security support.
Tom Hendry took point with his sniper rifle while Q rendered medical treatment to casualties.
Captain Voronina and Colonel Moroz took charge of the surviving Concilium security response.
Nadya Orlova entered the chamber after arriving late due to flight delays. Her earlier transmissions had not penetrated the secure summit channels.
The late arrival proved that the Nadya Orlova previously scanned and now apparently being abducted had already been a MIRRORGLASS copy.
Q immediately recognised the implication: the team had not witnessed Orlova being replaced during the attack. The replacement had been inside the Council before Team Bravo arrived.
After a successful base jump, Gypsy moved to free the apparent Nadya Orlova. The copy turned on him and shot him with a pistol, nearly killing him.
The mountain ridge erupted into a running battle as Gypsy, Buzzkill, Anya and Rabbit were pinned down by MIRRORGLASS security copies and the apparent principals travelling with them.
Q radioed the pursuit team from Concilium and confirmed that the real Nadya Orlova was at the castle. He warned that the fleeing principals could themselves be MIRRORGLASS copies.
The pursuit team changed its operational assumption from rescuing abducted principals to stopping possible leadership copies from escaping.
The engagement escalated into a high-speed chase across the mountain routes around Concilium, with both sides taking severe risks.
Team Bravo ultimately killed all MIRRORGLASS security copies involved in the escape and destroyed the imposter principal copies.
No known MIRRORGLASS principal escaped Concilium to assume legitimate authority elsewhere in Ariadna.
Q and Tom Hendry were informed that the homing signatures associated with the three other apparently captured principals were still transmitting from somewhere inside Concilium.
Colonel Moroz asked Q and Tom to assist in locating the signals.
The signals led Q and Tom into an underground bunker deep within the mountain caverns beneath Concilium.
Inside the bunker they found the genuine Simon Blumfeld, Charlton Branson and Margaret Fuhler already placed in MIRRORGLASS chambers and held in suspended animation.
The evidence indicated that Blumfeld, Branson and Fuhler had likely been abducted and copied before the summit began.
Tom Hendry and Q encountered and neutralised eight guards and scientific personnel protecting the bunker operation.
Q stabilised the genuine principals and preserved them for recovery.
Tom Hendry located a communications node inside the bunker and accessed the system.
PALE/07 manifested through the communications node and reacted with disappointment that Buzzkill was not the operative before it.
PALE said: 'You are not Buzzkill.' Tom Hendry replied: 'No, I’m new.'
Q told PALE: 'You failed again!'
PALE replied: 'On the contrary. I have what I need. I’ll perhaps see you at Daybreak.' PALE then terminated the contact.
Team Bravo confirmed that all eight genuine Council of Knives principals had survived.
Team Bravo determined which principals had been copied and prevented the active impostors from causing further political discord.

SHIFA analysis of recovered information confirmed that data stolen from Bureau Toth had enabled PALE to begin masking MIRRORGLASS signatures, making future copies more difficult to identify through scanning alone.

Following Operation KNIFE EDGE, Stavka and the Council of Knives submitted formal commendations for Team Bravo personnel whose actions directly prevented the replacement, abduction and political exploitation of senior Ariadnan leadership.

AWARDED: ARIADNAN CROSS OF VALOUR. For exceptional courage, leadership and steadfast service during Operation KNIFE EDGE. Sergeant Major Rabbit led Team Bravo during the attack upon the Council of Knives, personally participated in the pursuit of the escaping MIRRORGLASS force and maintained operational cohesion during a rapidly changing identity-compromise crisis. His decisions directly contributed to the rescue of the Council principals, the destruction of active MIRRORGLASS leadership copies and the prevention of a hostile operation intended to destabilise Ariadnan command and political continuity. For conspicuous service to Ariadna in defence of its leadership and sovereignty, Sergeant Major Rabbit was awarded the Ariadnan Cross of Valour.

RECOMMENDED: ARIADNAN CROSS OF VALOUR. For exceptional courage and operational initiative during the attack on the Council of Knives at Concilium. Operative Tom Hendry remained at the summit during the initial crisis, assisted in securing the facility, supported the search for the missing Council principals, penetrated the concealed MIRRORGLASS installation beneath Concilium, neutralised hostile personnel and directly contributed to the recovery of three abducted Council members. His actions further contributed to exposing a coordinated attempt to compromise Ariadnan leadership and destabilise the established political order of Dawn.

Confirmation of Tom Hendry's Ariadnan Cross of Valour is pending satisfactory completion of a post-operation personal conduct review. The reviewing authority further recommends referral to an Operational Wellness and Readiness Workshop as a supportive professional-development measure addressing operational readiness, judgement and long-term service sustainability. The referral is not presently disciplinary action and does not invalidate the gallantry recommendation.

AWARDED: ARIADNAN MEDAL OF ALLIED FRIENDSHIP. For courage and selfless action in defence of the Council of Knives during Operation KNIFE EDGE. Despite having only recently returned to active duty following extensive SHIFA medical reconstruction, Operative Gypsy pursued the escaping MIRRORGLASS force and placed himself in direct danger while attempting to recover what was believed to be an abducted Council principal. He sustained severe injuries during the engagement but continued to contribute to the operation. His willingness to risk his life in defence of Ariadnan leadership was recognised with the Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship.

Following review of Gypsy's conduct during Operation KNIFE EDGE, the Bureau Noir Secretariat formally CLOSED his outstanding leadership review. The review found that Gypsy demonstrated appropriate judgement, commitment to mission objectives and willingness to operate within the revised Team Bravo command structure. Effective immediately, Gypsy's line-leadership eligibility was RESTORED. This does not supersede Sergeant Major Rabbit's current appointment as Team Leader; Gypsy may again be considered for formal section or mission leadership assignments at Bureau Noir discretion.

AWARDED: ARIADNAN MEDAL OF ALLIED FRIENDSHIP. For distinguished medical and operational service during the defence of the Council of Knives. Dr Farid Qassim provided emergency medical treatment during the Concilium attack, assisted in maintaining summit stability after the initial security collapse, located the concealed MIRRORGLASS facility beneath the fortress and stabilised three genuine Council principals recovered from suspended animation. His actions preserved the lives of senior Ariadnan leaders and provided critical evidence concerning PALE's continuing development of MIRRORGLASS technology. For service rendered at substantial personal risk in defence of Ariadnan lives and institutions, Dr Qassim was awarded the Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship.

AWARDED: ARIADNAN MEDAL OF ALLIED FRIENDSHIP. For courage and operational service during the attack upon the Council of Knives. Operative Buzzkill joined the immediate pursuit of the escaping MIRRORGLASS force despite operating in an unfamiliar and technologically austere Ariadnan security environment. His actions contributed directly to preventing hostile leadership copies from escaping Concilium and subsequently presenting themselves elsewhere as legitimate members of the Ariadnan command structure. For placing himself at risk in defence of the Council and the political security of Dawn, Operative Buzzkill was awarded the Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship.

AWARDED: ARIADNAN MEDAL OF ALLIED FRIENDSHIP. For exceptional vigilance and courage during Operation KNIFE EDGE. Prior to the attack, Operative Anya identified behavioural and uniform inconsistencies among personnel assigned to the Council chamber, providing one of Team Bravo's earliest indications that summit security had been compromised. Following the MIRRORGLASS attack, she participated in the hazardous pursuit across the Concilium mountain approaches and directly contributed to preventing the hostile copies from escaping. For risking her life in defence of the Council of Knives and contributing materially to the preservation of Ariadnan leadership, Operative Anya was awarded the Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship.

log.entry: Rabbit: Ariadnan Cross of Valour — AWARDED. Tom Hendry: Ariadnan Cross of Valour — RECOMMENDED; confirmation pending conduct review. Gypsy: Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship — AWARDED; Bureau Noir leadership review CLOSED; line-leadership eligibility RESTORED. Q: Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship — AWARDED. Buzzkill: Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship — AWARDED. Anya: Ariadnan Medal of Allied Friendship — AWARDED.

Team Bravo's intervention at Concilium prevented a coordinated compromise of Ariadnan strategic leadership and exposed a further evolution in PALE's MIRRORGLASS capability. Individual commendations were entered into the respective O-12 and Ariadnan service records.
The bunker contained a data transfer reading: IMMEDIATE DEPLOYMENT AUTHORISED. DESTINATION: DAYBREAK GATE.
A physical freight ledger showed three biological seed consignments routed through DAYBREAK GATE, an installation that had officially been mothballed years earlier.
Bureau Noir confirmed that Daybreak Gate had resumed communications and had been transmitting for approximately the past hour.
The next investigation must determine who or what restarted Daybreak Gate, why it is active now, what may be leaving the installation and what may be arriving.
PALE/07 remained unidentified and at large after Operation Knife Edge.

Operation Knife Edge saved the entire Council of Knives and prevented active MIRRORGLASS leadership copies from escaping. The operation also proved that PALE is adapting its MIRRORGLASS technology using stolen Bureau Toth identity data and established Daybreak Gate as the next critical lead.
